Scans every module in  for -decorated
            methods, registers all discovered commands with Discord in a single bulk-overwrite call, then wires
            all interaction handlers.  Prefer this over calling  per
            module on startup — it uses one REST round-trip instead of N, avoiding rate limits.

params.description:
When non-null, registers commands as guild-scoped (instant propagation, ideal for development).

members.summary: Restricts a command to members who hold at least the specified Discord permission bits.
members.remarks:
Discord includes a computed permissions bitfield string on the member object
            embedded in MESSAGE_CREATE gateway events.  This attribute parses that value and
            checks it against .
            Guild owners implicitly hold the ADMINISTRATOR bit; they bypass all checks when
             is  (the default).
